name: doctor-child-inert-guard
title: Guard the child-inert contract with a doctor.sh check
description: The bridge will set TRELLIS_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1 in the parent so a dispatched child's copy of the generated Trellis extension returns at load. Nothing currently checks that the extension still has that guard, so a trellis update could silently end it. Add a doctor.sh check mirroring the existing SHIPPED_TOOLS section.
creator: tan
